answer: Delay-sequencing bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files one violet-sealed claim. It activates after a verifiable delta of 3 epochs; an ivory auditor replays the delay log. Filing early or skipping the delta burns it. First costs 40, the k-th 40+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-delay ring fails: a borrowed seal never matches its holder. Honest agents pay 40 once and reclaim the bond after a clean epoch.
